model.engine: ESS acceleration v2 (integration/ess-converged 9f4a292); launch presets not promoted (PR #18 QA-FAIL)

cg.basis: Typical low sports car. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 16–20.

frontTrack.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

rearTrack.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

grip.basis: Extreme-performance summer tire (C5 Z06 class) (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical modern sports car Cd 0.30–0.36 × 19–21 ft². —  Indicative range 5.5–7.5.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.6 Hz front ride frequency (sports).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.8 Hz rear ride frequency (sports).

frontMotion.basis: Short/long arm (double wishbone, upper/lower A-arms). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.5–0.7.

rearMotion.basis: Independent, upper/lower control arms (double wishbone). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.55–0.8.

frontUnsprung.basis: Short/long arm (double wishbone, upper/lower A-arms). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 80–110.

rearUnsprung.basis: Independent, upper/lower control arms (double wishbone). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 75–105.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.
